expectation: CD11b should give a membrane ring on a distinct minority of myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages, neutrophils), scattered singly or in small clusters in the lamina propria and stroma, with dim or no signal in epithelium.
observed: A: diffuse yellow haze follows the tissue, and bright dots of various sizes also lie on empty slide, so they are debris. B and C: a few saturated blobs on a hazy field, not ring-shaped cells. D: irregular smeared yellow patches, no clear membrane outline. E: one or two bright blobs and haze, not tied to CD66b cells.
why: There are no convincing membrane-ringed cells in a pattern: haze follows the tissue, and the bright spots are debris-like and also sit off-tissue.
